name: titan-for-sleeper
description: Build tooling for the Titan for Sleeper Chrome extension: bundles the Firebase SDK into dist/ and copies Titan's engine and Sleeper adapter.

scripts.build: esbuild src/firebase-ext.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=FB --minify --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/firebase.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['engine.js','sleeper.js'])fs.copyFileSync('../site/'+f,f)"
